description: This file defines a template class 'CompressedTuple' implementing the Empty Base Optimization (EBO) for tuples, allowing efficient storage of empty classes by inheriting from them. It includes internal helper structures and specialization to handle empty and non-empty types, providing member access via get<N>() functions.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::CompressedTuple
classes.description: A tuple class optimized with Empty Base Optimization, storing empty classes as base classes to save space.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Accesses the element at index N in the tuple, with overloads for lvalue, const lvalue, rvalue, and const rvalue references.
